capabilities: Ask questions about your notes to a locally run LLM
Index vault files on startup and on file modification
Open a query modal via shortcut or command
Point the plugin at a self-hosted model URL
extras: The main branch needs a separate Python indexing server; a JS-only branch avoids it but is described as slower, less developed, and must be built and installed manually. The README also documents the plugin's release process rather than usage.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask a language model questions about your own notes.

relations.evidence: you will need to run a lightweight python server to do the indexing for you next to your ollama

requires.name: Ollama plus a Python indexing server

summary: AI chat plugin that answers questions about your notes using a local Ollama model with a LlamaIndex-based index of the vault.
